pred_ddx.label: Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) with negative C-Kit staining

Leiomyoma: The tumor is described as a submucosal tumor with thick bands of smooth muscle and vascular channels, which is consistent with a leiomyoma. The tumor's origin from the muscularis propria of the small bowel and the absence of significant mitotic activity or tumor necrosis also support this diagnosis.
Gastrointestinal Stromal Tumor (GIST) wi: Although the tumor's smooth muscle components and vascular channels could suggest a GIST, the negative C-Kit staining makes this diagnosis less likely. However, some GISTs can have negative C-Kit staining, so it remains a possible diagnosis.
